findings: plan() is fail-closed and bounded: requires version-1 REGISTERED_EVIDENCE_ONLY registry, 1-4 unique string IDs, exact returned-ID match, name limited to the four approved preflight files, not trashed, non-Google-native, positive size within per-alias max_bytes (missing size rejected); alias/file-ID collisions with the live registry or within the selection raise before any write.

No extra grant needed: the proposal adds only bounded small-evidence-read with explicit max_bytes on the actual Picker-selected files under the existing drive.file scope; existing five aliases, output_folder_id, caller_uids and mode are preserved unmutated (tests assert non-mutation and retained grants).

No side effects beyond preparation: only Drive metadata reads (no download, no folder creation, no credential or live-config write); receipt claims (files_downloaded 0, remote_objects_created 0, credentials_changed false) match the code; installation remains a separate transaction.

Privacy sound: fresh root-only destination with umask 077, symlink and parent-permission checks, mkdir 0700, exclusive-create for the byte-exact original copy; stdout receipt carries only aliases and hashes, selected file IDs/names stay in the private destination.

Recovery fail-closed: existing destination refused so interrupted runs never overwrite; live registry re-read after planning detects concurrent change (LIVE_REGISTRY_CHANGED); recorded original/selection/proposal SHA-256 hashes bind the later exact installation to what was inspected.

Main protection request and readback match approved item 4: PR required with existing 'basic' check bound to app_id 15368 (GitHub Actions, unspoofable context), enforce_admins true, force pushes/deletion rejected, restrictions null with no writer-App bypass, zero GitHub reviewers explicitly compensated by recorded independent-desk-plus-operator merge approval; model secrets unchanged, correctly staged behind the separate canary.
